rca.title: Null pointer dereference in auth handler
rca.description: Unchecked access token header leads to uncaught exception under high load.
rca.root_cause: The code does not check if the 'authorization' header is present, leading to a null pointer dereference when the header is missing.
rca.suggested_fix: Add a null check for the 'authorization' header before attempting to split it.
rca.mechanism: Missing validation of input data (authorization header) leading to null dereference.

hypothesis_tree.mechanism: Missing validation of input data (authorization header) leading to null dereference.
Race condition due to high load causing intermittent failures.
contradicting_evidence: The bug is reproducible under high load, but the code does not show any signs of race conditions.

rca.title: Race condition in session cache
rca.description: Simultaneous token refresh corrupts memory cache entries.
rca.root_cause: The race condition occurs because multiple asynchronous calls to the refresh function can overwrite the cache entry for the same id before the previous call has completed.
rca.suggested_fix: Implement a locking mechanism or use a more robust caching strategy to prevent simultaneous writes to the cache.
rca.mechanism: Race condition due to simultaneous asynchronous operations modifying shared state.

hypothesis_tree.mechanism: Race condition due to simultaneous asynchronous operations modifying shared state.

rca.title: Off-by-one error in pagination slice
rca.description: Page bounds check incorrectly truncates the last result record.
rca.root_cause: The calculation of the 'end' index in the pagination logic is incorrect, leading to an off-by-one error.
rca.suggested_fix: Change the calculation of 'end' from 'start + size - 1' to 'start + size' to include the last record.
rca.mechanism: Logical error in index calculation for slicing the results array.
evidence_references: Line 4: const end = start + size - 1; // Bug: should be start + size

hypothesis_tree.mechanism: Logical error in index calculation for slicing the results array.
supporting_evidence: Line 4: const end = start + size - 1; // Bug: should be start + size

hypothesis_tree.mechanism: Incorrect handling of edge cases in pagination logic.
contradicting_evidence: The current implementation does not handle edge cases, but the primary issue is the off-by-one error.

rca.title: Hardcoded cryptographic fallback key
rca.description: Fallback HMAC key exposed in client-accessible bundle constants.
rca.root_cause: The fallback HMAC key is hardcoded in the source code, making it accessible to anyone who can access the client bundle.
rca.suggested_fix: Replace the hardcoded key with a secure key management solution or environment variable.
evidence_references: Line 1: export const FALLBACK_KEY = 'super_secret_dev_key_123'; // Bug: hardcoded secret

supporting_evidence: Line 1: export const FALLBACK_KEY = 'super_secret_dev_key_123'; // Bug: hardcoded secret

contradicting_evidence: The key is explicitly defined in the source code, indicating it is not a deployment issue.

rca.title: Uncaught JSON parse error
rca.description: Fails when external API returns invalid HTML instead of JSON.
rca.root_cause: The code does not handle the case where the response is not valid JSON, leading to an uncaught SyntaxError.
rca.suggested_fix: Implement error handling for JSON parsing to manage invalid responses gracefully.
rca.mechanism: Missing error handling for JSON parsing.
